newsitem.title: USA: Marvel says it has to OK Toy Biz shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Marvel says it has to OK Toy Biz shr buyback.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said Friday the stock buyback Toy Biz Inc announced yesterday needs consent from its Marvel Characters Inc unit.

Marvel, a major shareholder of Toy Biz, said in a statement it will seek approval for the consent from the U.S. Bankruptcy Court. It also said it "presumes that Toy Biz will obtain any necessary waiver from its bank lending group."
Marvel officials were not immediately available to comment further.

Toy Biz said yesterday it would buy back up to three million shares of its class A common stock, which it called undervalued at its current price. The shares were up 3/4 in midday trading Friday to 9-3/4.
The company has about 28 million shares outstanding.
Officials at Toy Biz were not immediately available to comment on Marvel's statement.
Earlier this month, bondholders of Marvel -- which filed for bankruptcy in late December -- said Marvel would consider their reorganization plan for the company.
The bondholders at the time had said they expected to complete their due diligence of Marvel today. A spokeswoman for the bondholders, however, said today it is unclear whether that will be the case.
